messages:
Miguel: Quick heads-up — I'm assembling the release notes for the v1.9.0 rollout next Tues. Need: compact RN copy, pinned model version, canary plan, and a standby oncall roster. High-level decisions: pin model v1.9.0-rc4, canary to 10% for 2h, rollback if errors >5% or p99 latency >1.5s for 10m.

Priya: @Miguel thanks — change window okay? We need to confirm DB migration-free and any config toggles. Also can we add a short note about quantization thresholds? :eyes:

Miguel: Window is 02:00–04:00 PT. No DB migrations. Quantization: feature-flagged, default off for this rollout. Will call it out in RN.

Jason: I can be primary oncall for the window. Requesting a second standby (preferably someone familiar with caching layer). I can do the first hour and hand off.

Alice: Draft RN snippet for internal announce — feel free to reuse: ```Release v1.9.0 — performance and runtime fixes. Pinned model: v1.9.0-rc4. Canary: 10% traffic for 2 hours. Rollback criteria: >5% 5xx or p99 >1.5s sustained for 10m. No DB migrations. No user-facing changes expected.```:thumbsup:

Priya: Nice. Add one line about 'observability tags' so SRE can filter canary traces: `canary=rn-1-9-0` and `owner=<team>`. Also flag the quantization note: "Quantization off by default; opt-in via qflag."

Miguel: Adding both. Also question — will deploybot pin the version automatically or do we need a manual pin step?

deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled deployment queued for 2026-04-14T02:00:00-07:00. Action required: confirm pin request with `/deploybot pin model v1.9.0-rc4` in this thread within 24h to auto-pin at deploy time.

Jason: I'll run the pin step once final RN copy is approved.

Alice: Two-line internal blurb for the staff channel: "Rolling v1.9.0 to hosted and dedicated — pinned to v1.9.0-rc4. Canary 10% for 2h. Oncall: Jason + standby (TBD). See internal RN for rollback criteria and observability tags."

Priya: One more ops check — canary health dashboard link pls when created. Also add a checkbox in RN for 'post-deploy evals' (quality tests) at +24h.

Miguel: Great. I'll finalize RN draft (short version + ops checklist) and drop it here by EOD. Jason, please confirm you'll run the `/deploybot pin model v1.9.0-rc4` once I post the final RN.

Jason: Confirmed. I'll pin and watch the canary dashboard.

Miguel: Thanks everyone. Final checklist I'm putting in the RN: 1) Pin command executed, 2) Canary config applied, 3) Observability filters active, 4) Standby roster confirmed, 5) Post-deploy evals scheduled. Will tag the RN with the deploybot link when queued. :white_check_mark:
